title: GET /connected/snapshot sends the server's absolute workspace path to the browser (catalogue.workspace).
expected: The service sends no absolute path to the page: run_activity.py:225-226 states 'Spend, run folders and absolute paths are not sent', and /connected/library (react_frontend/__init__.py:97-116) projects the snapshot down and drops the field. FINDINGS-SCHEMA: a leaked path is High.
actual: Every report page fetches /connected/snapshot?run=<folder>; its JSON holds catalogue.workspace = '/tmp/cs-C1/root/_engine' (src/deploy_workflow/credit_os_catalogue.py:517 `"workspace": str(workspace)` passes through admission.admitted and sources.enrich unchanged). No code under web/src reads the field (grep), and nothing draws it, so it is visible only in the network response.
suggested_change: Drop catalogue.workspace (and any other server-side path) in _visible_scope the way _library_index projects its fields, or stop writing it into the published catalogue.
